content.title: These Grocery Stores Are Open on Easter 2026, Plus Holiday Hours
content.text: It's Easter Sunday. If, at the last minute, you've just discovered that you’re missing an essential ingredient for brunch or dinner, you may be wondering which grocery stores will be open today.It's a fair question given Easter is one of the holiest days on the Christian calendar. Because of that, many businesses grocers and retailer chains are shuttered in observance of the April holiday.To ensure you get everything you need to make this year's Easter celebration a success, see below for a complete list of grocery stores that will be open on Sunday, April 5. In the list below, you’ll find a comprehensive guide on which grocery stores will be open, along with holiday hours and store locators so you can easily check openings, closings and other details on your preferred grocery store chain.Due to various state laws and other factors, it’s a good idea to confirm store hours before visiting any of the grocers in the roundup below in case the location nearest you is closed or operating with adjusted times this Easter.Grocery Stores Open on Easter 2026ACME: A majority of stores will be open.
